Error executing tool hd_script_run: script error at line 1, column 15: Syntax Error: Unresolved Variable
  printf("%d", q);
                ^
hint: a name that is not a variable, symbol or function. A variable must be assigned earlier in the same script before it is read - a global too: `if (0) { .n = 0; }` declares .n without resetting it. Globals start with '.', registers with '@' (@rax), pseudo-registers with '$' ($pid).
